decisions.reason: The same-message DEFER and MODIFY already capture that Transak-dependent wallet provisioning moves to the post-launch context.
This reward-access flow is specifically for fiat buyers using the Transak-provisioned wallet, so it cannot be available until the deferred post-launch Transak flow is added.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Having Transak available on day 1 is not especially important because our initial audience will be crypto users.
Therefore, I don't think it should delay the launch, provided we can still add it soon afterward.

(Im currently trying to complete the Transak setup, but I have to wait for the Mauritius incorporation website to be updated, after which it will take some days for Transak to tick it off)

decisions.reason: Deferring Transak availability does not change the $15 primary-mint price or its advertised commitment.
The source changes when the Transak path becomes available, not the primary-sale allocation rules.
The unlimited NFT ebook mint remains available through the crypto launch path; only the Transak fiat path is postponed.
The source does not change the optional tipping behavior, placement, or supported tip amounts.
The current About-page state does not promise day-one Transak availability, and its general mint and project copy remains valid.

The FAQ contains a Transak-specific fiat-buyer section, but the source does not determine whether that section should be hidden, rewritten as forthcoming, or retained until the post-launch integration.
The automatic $5 commission for coded referrals remains valid for the crypto mint path and is not changed by postponing Transak.
The timing of Transak availability does not change automatic prize delivery or the winner-notification flow.
Secondary-sale royalty enforcement and allocation are independent of the deferred Transak primary-mint path.
The source does not alter Small Block funding, tickets, eligibility, draw cadence, or winner selection.
